ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade automation platform tailored for Goa's hospitality and tourism industry, orchestrating bookings, permits, and vendor payments through hierarchical AI agents.

ideas.title: GoaWorkflows: Autonomous Multi-Agent Tourism Workflow Automation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting local business workflows resonates immediately with judges in the region, combining practical utility with advanced multi-agent execution.

ideas.pitch: A localized AI agent that captures engineering team knowledge directly from git commits, PR discussions, and local documentation to instantly onboard new developers.

ideas.title: GitContext: Developer Knowledge Archival and Onboarding Agent

ideas.pitch: A blazing-fast, training-free semantic routing system using kNN over exemplar indices to dynamically route user queries to the cheapest, most effective local or cloud LLM.

ideas.title: SemanticRouterGoa: Training-Free Query Router for Regional LLM Cost Reduction

ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases offline edge-AI capability and hardware utilization, appealing directly to technical judges looking for complex local execution.
